definitions.explanation: A group of things sharing common characteristics. Used as a standalone noun or as a suffix attached to other nouns to indicate a category or class.

examples.english: I like this kind of book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sort the documents by type.

examples.japanese: ⟦{穀物|こくもつ}→穀物：02806_kokumotsu⟧{類|るい}や⟦{豆|まめ}{類|るい}→豆類：19500_mamerui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: Grains and legumes are rich in nutrients.

notes:
USAGE:
As a suffix, {類|るい} attaches to nouns to create category labels: {魚|さかな}{類|るい} (fish, as a category), ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧{類|るい} (vegetables), {肉|にく}{類|るい} (meats). This usage is common in menus, nutrition labels, and classification systems.

As a standalone noun, {類|るい} means "kind" or "sort": ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{類|るい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧... (this type of...), {類|るい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ない→見る：00283_miru⟧ (unparalleled).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{穀物|こくもつ}→穀物：02806_kokumotsu⟧{類|るい} (grains)
- ⟦{魚介|ぎょかい}{類|るい}→魚介類：23435_gyokairui⟧ (seafood)
- ⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧ (humanity, humankind)
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (documents)
- {類|るい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ない→見る：00283_miru⟧ (unprecedented, unparalleled)
